_comment: Soundboard script for tools/gen-audio.mjs. Original lines only: never the book's boxed text (the repo is public). A clip's file is assets/audio/<id>.mp3; delete it to regenerate. A voice with no id is skipped until it has one.

clips.label: SFX: commlink buzzing
clips.sfx: An old commlink buzzing and vibrating on a bedside table in a quiet dark apartment, insistent, three rings

clips.label: Read-aloud: the wake-up call
clips.text: Your commlink drags you out of a dead sleep. The clock says it's too early for anything good. The caller ID says Juan Diablo, and Diablo doesn't call to chat.

clips.label: Diablo: rise and shine
clips.text: Rise and shine, chummer. Got work, and it pays. Meet's in an hour.

clips.label: Diablo: don't be late
clips.text: Don't be late, and don't be stupid. This Johnson's got class.

clips.label: Diablo: I just make introductions
clips.text: Hey, I just make the introductions. What happens after that is on you.

clips.label: SFX: Harley idling
clips.sfx: A heavy motorcycle engine idling in a rain-wet parking lot at night, then revving once

clips.label: Read-aloud: the meet
clips.text: The car is long, black and spotless. The man in the back seat is the same: good suit, good manners, nothing you could describe to Lone Star tomorrow. He gestures to the seats across from him.

clips.label: Johnson: please, sit
clips.text: Thank you for coming on short notice. Please, sit.

clips.label: Johnson: the job
clips.text: The job is simple. A certain young lady must miss an appointment. Not permanently. Just long enough to be embarrassing.

clips.label: Johnson: nobody gets hurt
clips.text: Let me be clear. My client wants her inconvenienced, not damaged. Nobody gets hurt.

clips.label: Johnson: no questions
clips.text: Who my client is, and why, are not part of the arrangement. Do we have an arrangement?

clips.label: Euphoria: do you know who I am?
clips.text: Do you have any idea who I am?

clips.label: Euphoria: get your hands off me
Euphoria: my people will find me
clips.text: My people will find me. You know that, right? Every single one of you is finished.

clips.label: Euphoria: fine, but I want my own room
clips.text: Fine. Fine! But I want my own room. And real coffee, not that soy drek.
